description: Explicit waivers for axe violations on /, /book/, /book/chapter-1/, and /404 against current main. A violation that is not listed fails site CI. A listed violation that no longer reproduces also fails, so remove the waiver when the underlying issue is fixed. These are current color-contrast failures in files this workflow does not own. After Beautifyer's visual-design PR merges, delete these contrast waivers (they no longer reproduce) and expect one new heading-order failure on / until that heading skip is fixed.
